record.name: Bright Data
record.one_liner: Bright Data provides web data infrastructure, scraping APIs, proxy networks, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for collecting and interacting with public website data.

auth.notes: API requests are authenticated using a Bearer token or API key passed in the Authorization header or via environment variables.

access.notes: Users can sign up for free starting with a self-serve tier offering 5,000 free credits per month with no credit card required.

api_surface.notes: Offers REST endpoints for datasets and scraping services, webhooks for data delivery, and client libraries for Python and Node.js.

mcp.notes: Bright Data provides an MCP server and tools for AI readers and agents to connect to the live web.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials are instantly obtainable with no credit card required, and there are fully documented REST APIs, SDKs, and an MCP server.

evidence.claim: Bright Data offers scraper APIs, web access APIs, proxy networks, and webhook integration.
Provides a 5,000 free credits per month self-serve tier, REST API endpoints using Bearer token authentication, and Python and Node.js SDKs.
Bright Data offers an MCP server tool for AI agents via SSE transport.
